title: Replace ActiveX controls
problem_statement: The application uses outdated ActiveX controls that are not supported in modern environments.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential incompatibility with modern operating systems and security vulnerabilities.
suggested_approach: Identify modern equivalents or alternatives for the ActiveX controls and refactor the application to use them.
success_criteria: All ActiveX controls are replaced with modern equivalents.
The application runs without errors on modern operating systems.

provenance.evidence: Reference to Microsoft ActiveX Data Objects 2.0 Library
